messages:
sophia: FYI - onboarding run for v3-ptq shows structured-output mismatches on funcalls. Not classic escape chars this time, it's types.
li: saw a couple examples in the canary logs where `expiry` was a unix int instead of an iso string, validator rejected it and we aborted the tool call.
derek: can you paste a sample?
sophia: example from canary: ```{
  \"tool\": \"create_invite\",
  \"args\": \"{\\\"user_id\\\": \\\"u_42\\\", \\\"expiry\\\": 1700000000}\"
}```
li: Oof. schema expects `expiry: string(datetime)`; our parser treats the args blob as JSON and then schema validator fails. Retry logic then sent the same payload again, causing a duplicate pending invite in 2 customers.
eva: is this PTQ-only? Did fp16/FP32 run same prompt?
sophia: fp16 emitted iso string as expected. PTQ run converted some date literals to integers — probably tokenization/decoding produced a compact numeric token sequence for that substring. Low-frequency but real in tail.
derek: short-term mitigation: add a coercion adapter - before failing, try a small set of tolerant coercions (int->iso using epoch seconds, numeric->string) with audit logging. If coercion succeeds, tag response as "coerced" and increment a telemetry counter.
li: agree, but make it opt-in via canary toggle. We don't want to mask real regressions forever. Also add a quota on coerced responses to avoid silently hiding widespread regressions.
eva: long-term: include type-preservation checks in the model onboarding tests. Golden prompts should assert that fields declared as strings remain strings across quantized builds. Fail PTQ builds that increase type-mutation rate by >0.05%.
sophia: proposed tasks: 1) canary toggle + coercion adapter + telemetry (sophia, li) 2) idempotency check on dispatcher to drop duplicate identical tool requests within a single LLM response (derek) 3) tokenizer-decoder parity test in PTQ CI with type-stability assert (eva + ci-bot).
ci-bot: queued job: `ptq-type-stability-check` against v3-ptq canary set - ETA ~30m.
ops-bot: customer-alert: 2 duplicate invites observed for customer: beta-co in last 6h. tagging ops for follow-up.
li: can we capture the raw token stream and diff tokenization between fp16 and ptq for failing samples? that would help pinpoint which token got merged into a numeric token.
derek: yes, add token-diff logging to the golden-runner. Also add a repro harness to feed specific substrings.
sophia: I'll open PR for coercion adapter and the canary toggle, link it here.
ci-bot: `ptq-type-stability-check` job passed baseline; will post detailed report in ~20m.
eva: if the PTQ alignment test fails later, we'll gate the PTQ release until we either fix quantization or expand the tokenizer to preserve token boundaries for date-like literals.
sophia: thanks all. tracking in epic `E-ptq-type-stability`. will follow up with PR link. :thumbsup:
